post.title:
Daikin vs LG 2026 AC 🔥 Same 5000W Cooling Capacity But Totally Different Engineering 👀

Both are 1.5 Ton 5 Star 2026 inverter ACs with nearly 5000 watts cooling capacity ❄️

But after opening the outdoor units, the engineering approach looks completely different 👀 Watch more on YT - Shubz Gadget Reviews 

In this reel I compare:
✅ Copper U-bend count
✅ Condenser thickness
✅ Fin density
✅ Refrigerant routing
✅ Compressor section
✅ Airflow design
✅ Overall outdoor unit engineering

Daikin shows a more compact and optimized condenser design with dense fin packing and cleaner refrigerant routing 🔵

LG comes with a rugged gold-fin condenser, thicker-looking copper tubing and a heavy-duty outdoor unit feel 🟡

This comparison helps understand:
➡️ Thin vs thick condenser design
➡️ Modern vs traditional AC engineering
➡️ Which outdoor unit looks more premium internally
➡️ Why same cooling capacity ACs can still be engineered very differently

Which one would you choose for Delhi summers? ☀️👇
